title: Does a probe built on a concept vector flag evaluation-awareness ('I am being tested')?

original_idea.body: Extract an evaluation-awareness direction from eval-vs-deployment contrast prompts, train a linear probe, test held-out generalization, and compare to a judge model.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: detecting eval-awareness addresses gamed safety evals/scheming, a critical pathway.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Extract direction + linear probe with public contrast prompts; guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (probe firing on test-flavored prompts vs judge).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Eval-gaming/scheming detection labs are only starting; open models, high-leverage.

novelty.reasoning: Eval-awareness steering exists; probe-based detection may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Probe-detection framing may be partly open.
